title: The School Manual of the Open Palm
summary: A school manual of the Azure Sky palm healers that carries a student from plain mending to the great gift of the bountiful palm.

title: Manual of the Sapphire Pulse School
summary: A manual of the pulse school that teaches the reading and the steadying of the heartbeat and the crowning recall of the breath.

title: The Court Book of Returning Breath
summary: A court book of silken healing that cleanses curse and poison and calls back the breath before it is gone.

title: Canon of the Boundless Vital Field
summary: A canon for those whose field of qi reaches beyond the body that spreads a mending field and a resurgent pulse across it.

title: The Codex of the First Heartbeat
summary: A codex for those with a formed Core that roots healing in the first heartbeat of life and ends in the origin bloom.

title: The Wind-Sworn Book of Tireless Hands
summary: A school book of the wind-sworn healers that drills long hours of tending and a purge that ends in a tireless grace.

title: Manual of the Wide Sky Healers
summary: A manual of healers of the open land that mends the working crowd and returns the fallen with an unflagging surge.

title: The Oath of the Unflagging Pulse
summary: A sworn text of the pulse school whose healers promise mercy and a last attempt to save any who still breathe.

title: Canon of the Great Draw of Life
summary: A canon of the great draw that pulls life from the wide field into the wounded and ends in the greathand renewal.

title: The Unbroken Oath Codex of Vitality
summary: A codex of the unbroken oath of the Gale healers that links mending and returning into a single cycle of life.
